title: Classification and surgical treatment of temporomandibular joint calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease: a single-center case series
html: This study aimed to classify calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease of the temporomandibular joint and evaluate the therapeutic outcomes. Surgically treated patients from January 2020 to September 2025 were classified into three types based on lesion location and extent. Type I involved the superior compartment with or without skull base destruction. Type II affected the inferior compartment with or without condylar destruction. Type III involved both compartments affecting the condyle and skull base.
